_comment: CURRENT MODE = AIRBAND-ONLY (2026-06-28, for air travel): only airband runs on the RTL '970 dongle'; digital (SDRTrunk) + 70cm are PAUSED. Running all three overloaded the 2018 mini — SDRangel's 70cm 8 MHz channelizer pegged ~420% CPU, load hit ~17, and SDRTrunk died. sdrangel-restore.py is in airband-only mode (70cm route commented out); SDRTrunk launchd agent booted-out. Re-enable 70cm/digital by uncommenting and reloading the agents. Full architecture when enabled: airband on RTL dongle (serial 83241970, the '970 dongle'); 70cm on RSP-B (SDRplayV3 1809063632) single-tuner, 8 MHz window 442.1-450.1; digital (MTRTRS+TACN) on RSP-A/SDRTrunk. NOTE: SDRangel SDRplayV3 path is SINGLE-TUNER ONLY and crashes on (a) RSPduo dual-tuner attempts and (b) rapid bulk channel ops at wide sample rates. Stable recipe: change devSampleRate GRADUALLY, add/delete channels ONE AT A TIME with delays. At 8 MHz set bandwidthIndex=7 (8 MHz IF) or window edges roll off ~15 dB. SDRangel reverts to a stale plist on crash; persistence handled by native presets (REST) + macos/bin/sdrangel-restore.py (idempotent) + sdrangel-start.sh launcher (crash-tested), with etc/mac/com.scannerproject.sdrangel.plist watchdog available (not auto-installed). AUDIO: every channel on both routes outputs to SDRangel 'System default device' (index -1, follows the OS default = Mac mini Speakers), unmuted, volume 2; audio engine confirmed live at 48 kHz.

airband._device: RTL-SDR 83241970 (970 dongle), center 118.925 MHz, 2.4 Msps, AM, 8 kHz channels
_needs_confirmation: Memphis ARTCC low sector over BNA

70cm._device: RSP-B SDRplayV3 1809063632, center 446.1 MHz, 8 Msps (442.1-450.1), bandwidthIndex 7 (8 MHz IF), NFM 12.5 kHz
70cm._note: Carrier (power) squelch -77 dB (~12 dB above the -89 dBFS noise floor at 8 MHz/IF7), not CTCSS; PL tones recorded for future tone-squelch. More local repeater outputs (442-450) can be added gently into this window.

ground_reference._note: NOT currently deployed. Standard federal/ham channel plans, band-accurate everywhere. Could go on a 2nd dongle or swap with 70cm if needed.
